few.name: report_progress
few.description: Update the short line in the pet's speech bubble. Use plain language describing what is happening right now, e.g. "Moving 12 files". Call this before any step that takes more than a moment.

line.description: Six words or fewer works best

few.name: show_preview
few.description: Show the user exactly what you are about to change and wait for approval. Use this before any batch of file moves. Returns whether they approved.

note.description: Anything the user should know before approving

all.name: report_progress
all.description: Update the short line in the pet's speech bubble. Use plain language describing what is happening right now, e.g. "Moving 12 files". Call this before any step that takes more than a moment.

line.description: Six words or fewer works best

all.name: show_preview
all.description: Show the user exactly what you are about to change and wait for approval. Use this before any batch of file moves. Returns whether they approved.

note.description: Anything the user should know before approving

all.name: ask_user
all.description: Ask the user a question and wait for an answer. Use this only when the request is genuinely ambiguous in a way that changes what you would do, not to confirm steps you are already authorized to take.

options.description: Offer concrete choices when you can; it is faster than free text

all.name: finish
all.description: Declare the task complete or blocked. Only call this after you have verified the outcome. Supply evidence the user can open: destination folders, created files, URLs. If a required step is unresolved, report success=false and say what is missing.

headline.description: For work: one sentence, past tense, e.g. "Sorted 23 files into 4 folders". For a question: the answer itself, addressed to the user.

unresolved.description: What is still outstanding, if anything

usedMemories.description: Ids of <memory> items you actually relied on, if any
